text.title: FreshDrop courier bag, insulated, 3 variants
text.hypothesis: a bag with a separate cold compartment keeps food cold for 40 minutes for the courier on the route
text.model: a foam mock-up of the bag, 30 × 40 cm, built in our office
text.people: 5 couriers and 2 shop staff, tested on the route
text.sc1: courier takes a 4-stop route with hot and cold orders
text.sc2: courier takes a 4-stop route with hot and cold orders
text.sc3: courier takes a 4-stop route with hot and cold orders
text.cr1: food stays at 4 °C or lower for 40 minutes
text.cr2: food stays at 4 °C or lower for 40 minutes
text.cr3: food stays at 4 °C or lower for 40 minutes
text.ch1: thicker inner wall, cold pack moved to the side
text.ch2: thicker inner wall, cold pack moved to the side
text.ch3: thicker inner wall, cold pack moved to the side
text.decision: criteria met on 2 of 3 variants; move the second variant to production; revisit the handle
